title: P1 source-bound evidence scope ownership policy
rawUserRequest: 目标：执行计划，到全部完成。 我授权给你自动执行，写入到每个工单的Contract里。遇到流程问题，要先开工单修正。不要采用临时修补方案。

declaredIntent.summary: Repair the source-bound evidence ownership deadlock before #634 resumes.

outOfScope: Modifying #634 active Contract, Summary, source, derived evidence, or Outcome.
Modifying the distinct stale-source remediation owned by #643.
Modifying #617, #648, #656, release metadata, semantic tags, or provider Releases.
Hand-editing any derived documentation artifact or allowing unrelated documentation through a source-bound exception.

sources.reason: Authoritative P1 report and correction acceptance.
Blocked predecessor whose Finish source change revealed the ownership deadlock.
Distinct stale-source remediation that must remain independent.

riskAssessment.reason: The policy must permit only declared generated evidence for a source-changing Work Item while preserving fail-closed rejection of unrelated documentation and stale evidence.

reasons: P1 governed Finish lifecycle defect with source-bound evidence and generated-document ownership.

executionDecision.reason: Normal ai-start was attempted on latest origin/main and failed because a foreign linked worktree has branch/task mismatch: codex/integrate-finish-truth-v5 != codex/finish-truth-final-v5. The user authorized governed corrective execution; this bootstrap Contract records that fact without mutating the foreign worktree.

preReviewWarnings: The normal startup failure is a separate foreign linked-worktree integrity defect; do not weaken or repair it in this Work Item.
Generated documentation may only be produced by its canonical generators after the new ownership policy is validated.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Bind source/derived ownership policy before code changes and before final lifecycle evidence.

acceptance: The Contract can explicitly declare a bounded source-bound generated-evidence ownership policy before any derived artifact is written.
Preflight accepts a source-changing Contract that has the bounded policy and rejects the same Contract when matrix or required generated ownership is missing.

Scope Guard accepts only a changed capability-bound source plus the exact policy-authorized generated evidence set; it rejects unrelated documentation and a matrix change without its required generated descendants.
Regression coverage reproduces the #634 Finish-source shape without modifying #634 and proves the policy remains fail closed for #643-style unrelated stale source changes.
The standard lifecycle produces automatic blocked/success Outcome evidence; no derived documentation is hand-edited.
guidelines: Use the Capability Truth matrix as the source of dependency facts; do not duplicate capability row lists.
Keep source ownership and derived-output ownership explicit and machine-validated in the Contract.
Allow only canonical generator outputs and retain fail-closed behavior for unrelated documentation.
Use red-green-refactor and do not modify predecessor Work Item scope as a workaround.

intent.problem: #634 correctly fails source-bound evidence validation after a Finish source change, but its Contract cannot safely own the required generated documentation without colliding with a separate stale-documentation remediation. The result is a lifecycle deadlock rather than a truthful correction path.
constraints: Do not broaden #634 as a temporary workaround.
Preserve rejection of unrelated documentation changes.
intent.rationale: A bounded Contract-declared source-to-derived ownership policy makes generator writes auditable before they occur and preserves the existing evidence-integrity boundary.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A Finish source-changing Contract declares required source-bound generated evidence.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Preflight and Scope Guard accept canonical generator outputs after explicit policy validation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused red-green tests use a temporary Contract and Capability Truth matrix matching the #634 source shape.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A capability-bound source change omits policy-authorized derived evidence.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Preflight or Scope Guard fails with an actionable ownership diagnostic before Finish.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused negative tests for omitted matrix and omitted generated descendants.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An unrelated or stale documentation path is added to the diff.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The policy does not authorize it and Scope Guard fails closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused #643-style negative control with an unrelated documentation path.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user authorized automatic execution and requested that authorization be recorded in each Work Item Contract; scope is limited to this governed corrective lifecycle.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff; generated evidence is regenerated from restored source rather than hand-edited.
